title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts: Unreachable-Customer Credit for Wrong-Address Disputes
content:
**Clause.** In a wrong-address dispute on a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts account, the unreachable-customer credit counts the rating exclusions granted on the disputed violation's batch for the reason "customer unreachable": 2 or more give a credit of 2 points; exactly one gives 1 point; none gives no credit.

The exclusions counted are those already granted on the account for ratings on that batch, with the exclusion reason customer unreachable. Exclusions granted for out-of-stock items, store delay or app outage are not counted here.

| Customer-unreachable rating exclusions on the batch | Unreachable-customer credit |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 points |
| Exactly 1 | 1 point |
| None | None |

## Cases (hypothetical batches)

- A Triple Delivery Batch with two ratings excluded because the customer was unreachable: 2 points.
- A Double Delivery Batch with one such exclusion and one exclusion for store delay: 1 point.
- A batch with a low rating whose exclusion was never granted: none.
